Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information and inspect the bidding documents from; Radford Matiya, The Chief Procurement Officer, Dedza District Council, Room 9 at Dedza District Council Offices, Phone: 0999428821/0998655425, Email: radfordmatiya@gmail.com/judithmaseya@gmail.com during working hours from 07:30am to 12:00 Noon and from 2:00pm to 4:30pm. 
  2. Bids must be delivered in sealed envelopes clearly marked Contract number, Contract name and Constituency at or before 14:00pm on Tuesday, 27th October, 2026 at the address indicated below.
